semantics: In-model joint ablation (ecm/caf/crosslink of the selected spots set to the section's 5th percentile; absorption unchanged). Fractions are of a full minimum-cut breach (B_cell) and of the all-spots ablation limit (B_mAb). 'density' ranks spots by their local matrix score without any graph; 'random cut' draws spots from the minimum cut. Zero single-spot B_cell effects away from the cut follow from max-flow/min-cut duality.
